name: Lovely Island
source:
Romantic story about the adventures of the main character and four girls on a deserted island in the nearest future. Will you solve the riddle of the island? Will you get romance with one of the beautiful girls?

[From Steam (removed)]
translation:
讲述了主人公和四个女孩在最近的未来的荒岛上冒险的浪漫故事。你能解开岛上的谜团吗？你会和一位美丽的女孩发生浪漫吗？

[来自Steam（已删除）]
